title: Cosmic Muse in Chaos
description: A cluttered teenage bedroom with yellow walls, a messy wooden bed with blue and pink blankets, scattered papers, bottles, and trash on the floor. A person’s bare feet are visible in the foreground while a glowing ethereal female figure composed of swirling colorful smoke, stars, and multiple faces emerges from a computer monitor displaying code.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal scene of a messy teenage bedroom with yellow walls covered in drawings, an unmade wooden bed with blue and pink blankets, floor littered with papers, bottles, and trash. In the foreground are a person's bare feet. A glowing ethereal female spirit made of colorful swirling smoke, stars, and multiple floating female faces emerges dramatically from a computer monitor on a desk displaying lines of code, with cosmic energy flowing through the dark space above.
